summary: Coastal communities and emergency responders benefit from real-time hurricane decision support provided by the Automated Solution Generation System (ASGS). This system automates coastal ocean modelling to inform critical storm surge forecasting and management decisions. The ASGS operates in the context of tropical cyclones and coastal regions, addressing the sector of disaster risk reduction and management. Its impact is to enhance the preparedness and response of communities to natural disasters, particularly in coastal areas. The project's focus on real-time decision support and storm surge forecasting is relevant to the sectors of climate action and disaster risk reduction.
